slots.release.changed.defaultMessage: {slot} changed meanwhile: its writer is no longer the one shown. Look again.
slots.release.changed.description: Release Slot… refused: the slot ({slot}, such as slot-b) was released or taken by another run while the question was open.

slots.release.live.defaultMessage: {slot}'s writer is still running in this Hive: stop the agent, or end or keep what it left running, first.
slots.release.live.description: Release Slot… refused: the session writing in the slot ({slot}) still runs in this Hive, or Hive still follows the processes it left running (End or Keep Running in the agent's ⋯ menu settles them).

slots.release.notEnded.defaultMessage: Some of the processes listed still run: Windows didn't let Hive end them, so {slot} wasn't released. Try again, or release it without ending them.
slots.release.notEnded.description: Release Slot… with "End these processes first": ending the listed processes failed (Windows refused), so the slot ({slot}) was left as it was.

slots.release.otherHive.defaultMessage: {slot} is held by another Hive that is still running (process {pid}): release it there, or quit that Hive first.
slots.release.otherHive.description: Release Slot… refused: another running copy of Hive (its process id {pid}) holds the slot ({slot}).

slots.setting.bad.defaultMessage: That isn’t a slot setting Hive has.
slots.setting.bad.description: An error: a request to change a setting of “Slots and copies” named one that doesn’t exist.

slots.setting.badSize.defaultMessage: The number of review and check copies is a whole number from 1 to 32.
slots.setting.badSize.description: An error: the number of review and check copies given isn’t a whole number from 1 to 32.

slots.setting.badText.defaultMessage: A slot script or list of files is text of at most 4,000 characters.
slots.setting.badText.description: An error: a slot script or list of copied files given isn’t text, or is too long.
